item.title: It’s too bad I woke up again this morning
item.description:
Early in the Day

As soon as I woke up today, I immediately started doing the same things over and over again, just like yesterday: watering the plants, warming up my motorcycle, feeding the cat, and reading a little from the Upanishads

Midday

Since it’s October now, that means the weather is at its hottest in the southern part near the Earth’s equator, so I spent my time sitting in front of the fan as much as possible; I thought it would be impossible to get up and do anything in such intense heat
